visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a young male with styled dark hair, wearing a white t-shirt, taking a sip from a white paper cup through a straw. His eyes are slightly narrowed in enjoyment. Behind him is a vertical corrugated metal wall. Bright pink and yellow text overlays appear at the top. (2) The scene transitions to a wider view of an outdoor beverage stand named 'ZUBIBA' in an urban alleyway. A group of people are standing in a queue. Kai is seen sitting on the left side of a bar-height counter, looking towards the shop window where staff are visible. (3) Close-up shots highlight the shop's unique decor, including a giant white coffee cup with a cartoon character inside. The camera then focuses on the hands of the staff as they operate machines. White cups with the black 'ZUBIBA' logo are lined up on the counter. (4) A series of close-up shots display the shop's menu signs for 'Fruit Special Lattes.' The signs feature photos of layered drinks like Strawberry, Mango, Durian, and Avocado. Fruit stickers are added as digital overlays. (5) Kai is shown standing on a busy street, speaking directly to the camera with high energy. The background is a slightly blurred city street with passers-by. Large white and pink text captions float near his head. (6) Back at the shop counter, Kai is shown waiting in the bright sunlight. A sun icon with a thermometer overlay indicates '37度高溫.' He points to his face while discussing his makeup, looking slightly sweaty but still enthusiastic. (7) The camera provides close-up of the drink preparation. Blueberries are spooned into a cup, followed by milk and a dark espresso pour. The staff's hands are precisely placing lids and preparing the final product. (8) Kai is seated at the counter, holding the finished blueberry latte. He uses a straw to stir the purple fruit layer at the bottom. He takes a large gulp, closes his eyes, and gives a thumbs-up gesture. (9) The final phase shows a screen recording of the shop's information on Google Maps and Instagram. Kai is visible in the background, still sitting at the counter and enjoying his drink.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio starts with a high-arousal male voice providing an energetic introduction. A background music track with an upbeat, lo-fi electronic pop beat and a steady mid-tempo rhythm (approx 110 BPM) begins simultaneously, creating a cheerful atmosphere. (2) A distinct 'ding' sound effect marks the transition to an outdoor scene. The background ambient noise shifts to include low-level urban chatter. The main speaker continues to narrate with a friendly tone, describing the popular 'Fruit Special Latte'. (3) The sound of a metal cup hitting a counter and liquid being poured creates sharp, percussive transients. These incidental noises are clear. The BGM remains constant, while the narrator lists fruit flavors with a rhythmic vocal delivery. (4) A 'whoosh' transition sound effect leads into a dialogue segment. The primary male speaker interacts with an off-camera friend. Their conversation is casual and humorous, characterized by laughter and higher vocal pitch. (5) A percussive 'clink' and the sound of a lid snapping are audible as the narration resumes. The speaker's voice is enunciated and clear, standing well above the background music. The spectral brightness of the track is high. (6) A cartoon-style 'slurp' sound effect is used for comedic emphasis as the character drinks. This is followed by a 'pop' sound and a short burst of a meme-style laugh track. (7) The video concludes with a final summary from the narrator. His voice is authoritative yet warm. The music reaches a crescendo with bright synthesizer pads before fading out. A final digital 'click' coincides with the closing info.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a high-energy lifestyle recommendation for a specific boutique coffee shop, ZUBIBA, focusing on their unique fruit-infused lattes. Through a combination of fast-paced visual editing, energetic narration, and humorous social-media style interactions, the creator aims to showcase the brand's aesthetic appeal, the freshness of their ingredients, and a personal endorsement of the product's taste to an urban youth audience.
